title: #1 Sean Iddings: The Ultimate Competitive Advantage

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to Investing by the Books podcast by Red Eye.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to Investing by the Books podcast by Red Eye. And with me in the studio, I have Nicholas Sav Oas. Today, we are excited to get the first podcast episode going. And today we will talk with Sean Eddings, who wrote two books on intelligent fanatics together with Ian Castle.

key_points.text: From the framework of Red Eye Quality Rating, what will the episode focus on today, Nicholas?
key_points.evidence_quote: From the framework of Red Eye Quality Rating, what will the episode focus on today, Nicholas?

key_points.text: So the quality rating covers business, people, financials and this one is about people, the management and the owners.
key_points.evidence_quote: So the quality rating covers business, people, financials and this one is about people, the management and the owners.

key_points.text: Yeah, and we can really hear that from the subtitle of the first book, How Great Leaders Builds Sustainable Companies.
key_points.evidence_quote: Yeah, and we can really hear that from the subtitle of the first book, How Great Leaders Builds Sustainable Companies, and the second title is standing on the shoulders of giants, also a great concept.

key_points.text: What are your thoughts on the books?
key_points.evidence_quote: What are your thoughts on the books?

thesis: The episode focuses on the 'intelligent fanatic' model as a blueprint for building dominant, sustainable businesses, illustrated by the host's application of these principles to launch a business-oriented real estate photography service. The speakers argue that successful leaders often come from different fields, allowing them to enter competitive industries with a unique, non-business-oriented perspective that creates a sustainable edge.
